qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Network of specialized digital consultancies with high talent retention, but lacks proprietary software IP or locked-in toll booths. Margins are capped at ~14% EBIT and day rates face intense procurement competition and AI coding automation deflation.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (Moat & Pricing Power, REJECT). Italian IT consulting network with solid organic execution, but operates as a talent-dependent service provider selling billable hours without proprietary software lock-in or pricing power above wage inflation. Highly vulnerable to corporate procurement pressure and AI software development deflation.
qualitative.evidence: Revenue grew from €1,250.2M (2020) to €2,300.5M (2024), with EBIT margins stable between 13.6% and 15.1% (€330.4M EBIT in 2024). Net cash position reached €349.1M at year-end 2024. While reported ROIC appears high at ~20-24% due to an asset-light consulting balance sheet, Reply lacks structural switching costs or pricing power: clients regularly tender IT integration projects via competitive corporate RFPs. The service model faces structural margin compression as AI coding agents commoditize routine digital services.
